definitions: To make something physical or tangible.
To give a physical form to an abstract concept or idea.
To express or represent something through physical action or embodiment.
examples: The artist sought to physicalize her emotions in the sculpture.
They tried to physicalize the complex theory through a series of experiments.
The actor was able to physicalize the character's inner turmoil.
pastTenses: physicalized (simple past), physicalized (present perfect), physicalized (past perfect)
